brief.purpose: A local-first product creation tool for designers and frontend builders that turns an initial brief into a polished, editable, runnable interface
brief.concept: A single continuous solid shape starts as an open imperfect square and resolves through one decisive diagonal cut into a precise finished corner; the intentional gap is the editable draft and the resolved corner is the working product. Treat this only as an abstract trademark, never as a depicted object. Avoid loops, knots, ribbons, layers, panels, documents, browser windows, play symbols, sparkles, robots, chat bubbles, code marks, cursors, and letterforms
brief.style: Professional identity-design logo mark, not an illustration or icon scene; one-color solid vector silhouette, one connected component plus at most one bold negative-space cutout, visually ownable and drawable from memory in two seconds. Must survive 16 px, black-and-white printing, stamping, and embroidery. No gradients, shading, highlights, texture, perspective, depth, shadows, outlines, secondary accents, app tile, text, or tiny detail
brief.palette: pure carbon black #151515 only; no other visible color

candidates.direction: Bold geometric silhouette with memorable negative space and the fewest possible shapes.
candidates.prompt: App: Draftly. Purpose: A local-first product creation tool for designers and frontend builders that turns an initial brief into a polished, editable, runnable interface. Core symbol: A single continuous solid shape starts as an open imperfect square and resolves through one decisive diagonal cut into a precise finished corner; the intentional gap is the editable draft and the resolved corner is the working product. Treat this only as an abstract trademark, never as a depicted object. Avoid loops, knots, ribbons, layers, panels, documents, browser windows, play symbols, sparkles, robots, chat bubbles, code marks, cursors, and letterforms. Visual style: Professional identity-design logo mark, not an illustration or icon scene; one-color solid vector silhouette, one connected component plus at most one bold negative-space cutout, visually ownable and drawable from memory in two seconds. Must survive 16 px, black-and-white printing, stamping, and embroidery. No gradients, shading, highlights, texture, perspective, depth, shadows, outlines, secondary accents, app tile, text, or tiny detail. Palette: pure carbon black #151515 only; no other visible color. Create a distinctive, original product icon with simple geometry, excellent silhouette, clear hierarchy, no letters, no words, no watermark, no device mockup, and no UI screenshot. Candidate direction 1: Bold geometric silhouette with memorable negative space and the fewest possible shapes. Render only one standalone brand symbol, centered and front-facing, with no enclosing app tile and no cast shadow. Keep all visible artwork within the central 72 percent of a square canvas. The entire background, including every edge and corner, must be one perfectly uniform flat chroma color #00FF00. Do not use that chroma color inside the icon.
